|notes=The [[Luke? Luuuuke! (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|2005 Gold Edition wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. Gold targets the opposing character with the highest printed power, prevents a drain there and is immune to Alter. The intermediate publisher face retains the drain ban, specifies the target is at a site and removes Alter immunity. The dated June replacement requires a friendly non-droid, also prohibits movement, can target a Jedi at a site and caps your loss to those drains at 1 Force. The gallery face prints collector 26 while both sheets print 27. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=2 Players Committee original sheet, p. 2, slip 27]. [[:File:VS11O-27-Luke_Luuuuke.png|June replacement slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=3 Players Committee final sheet, p. 3, slip 27]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071122140158id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v11/ds/lukeluuuuke.gif Earlier issuer full face, captured 22 November 2007]. The exact intermediate publication day is unknown.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards11.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to cards #8 and #27 on 25 June 2007); page 3, slip 27. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
